verdict.rationale: Jan runs models entirely on your own hardware, positions itself as 'Privacy First' with everything running locally, and its privacy page states 'Zero data collection until you say so.' Together these let a user keep their data off any vendor's servers, so it cannot be used for training. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party statement that user data is never used for model training, documentation of the opt-in data-collection controls, guidance on training policies when routing to cloud providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
